description: This file defines authentication-related API types for Kubernetes, including TokenReview, TokenRequest, SelfSubjectReview, and associated data structures and constants.

classes.name: TokenReview
classes.description: Represents a token authentication request and response.

classes.name: TokenReviewSpec
classes.description: Contains the token to be reviewed and target audiences.

classes.name: TokenReviewStatus
classes.description: Indicates whether the token is authenticated and associated user info.

classes.name: UserInfo
classes.description: Holds user identity information for authentication.

classes.name: TokenRequest
classes.description: Represents a request for a service account token.

classes.name: TokenRequestSpec
classes.description: Parameters for requesting a token, including audiences and expiration.

classes.name: TokenRequestStatus
classes.description: Result of a token request, including token string and expiration.

classes.name: BoundObjectReference
classes.description: References an object (Pod or Secret) that a token is bound to.

classes.name: SelfSubjectReview
classes.description: Contains user info about the requesting user, with impersonation support.

classes.name: SelfSubjectReviewStatus
classes.description: Holds user attributes of the requester.
